note:
The portrait supplied by the curator, attached after the curator confirmed the identification a second time.

The frame is the Getty editorial photograph by David Fenton taken at the Days of Rage on October 11, 1969: Jacobs in a football helmet, speaking into a reporter's microphone at the defaced base of the Haymarket police statue that the Weathermen had bombed three days earlier. The date on the caption is the same day as the arrest recorded in batch 165, and the scene is the one the biography already describes from a contemporary eyewitness account — he was still at liberty, addressing the crowd, immediately before the final march.

It is rights-managed and NPPC holds no licence. See database/data/photos/CREDITS-john-jacobs.md for the full provenance and the fair-use reasoning, which is written down rather than assumed.
